description: Deploy MATLAB-generated code to embedded hardware using Embedded Coder. Use when configuring code generation for microcontrollers (STM32, Raspberry Pi, ARM Cortex), setting up PIL/SIL verification, disabling dynamic memory allocation, or configuring hardware-specific code generation settings. Covers ERT-based configurations, processor-in-the-loop testing, memory constraints, and the MEX→SIL→PIL verification progression.
